doc.title: Bill Berry and Buster Cooper interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995

title: Ellington and Strayhorn's collaboration
summary: Duke would hand off unfinished tunes to Strayhorn, who returned perfect solutions.

story.theme_name: Duke Ellington and his orchestra, as others knew them
story.community_name: Duke Ellington: the band, the man, his men

blocks.x: Well it seems to me like a perfect collaboration. And okay, Duke and Strayhorn was fantastic. I’ve seen Duke, he started tunes, he’d say, “Here, Stray, I can’t turn the corner now on this one. Fix this for me.” You can tell.

Or over the phone. “Strayhorn, I’m stuck here, you know with this, do something with it,” and the way the stories go I’m sure it’s true, is Strayhorn would send something out that was like perfect, like as though they were reading each other’s minds.
